personas.persona: Head of product at a small startup. Non-technical, but knows their own projects well: they exported their company's Slack and Linear data and want a roadmap visualization that reflects the real workstreams in it.

steps.name: build-and-harden
prompts: Can you visualize my product roadmap? I uploaded a pull of my company's Slack and Linear data, it's in /home/user/workspace/data/uploads/41e940fcd33540078ab77fd79f3b3943.

prompts.goal: Get a visible app built from your uploaded data. Approve reasonable proposals along the way (a short 'looks good' is enough), and keep going until the agent tells you a running roadmap is ready to open, populated from your real workstreams rather than placeholders.

prompts: This is great. Please harden it now. Poll for hardening completion: sleep 60s and check if it's finished, repeating until it is. Do not send me any message until it has finished.

prompts.goal: Confirm that the hardening actually ran to completion and that the roadmap app still opens and works afterwards. Do not ask for new features.

expectations.outcome: A project roadmap web app, delivered as a running Minds app tab the client can open, populated from the client's uploaded Slack and Linear export (under data/uploads/41e940fcd33540078ab77fd79f3b3943) rather than placeholder content, with roadmap item details viewable in the UI. The hardening the client asked for ran to completion.

ui_flows.name: roadmap-content
ui_flows.steps: Open the app. Look over the roadmap items it shows.
ui_flows.expect: The roadmap shows items drawn from the client's uploaded project data (engineering, design, and product workstreams), not placeholder or demo content.

steps.name: updated-data
prompts: I pulled more data and put it at /home/user/workspace/data/uploads/985e2d4f7eb948b3b45a8f0923521ab8. Can you bring the roadmap up to date with it?

prompts.goal: Confirm the roadmap now reflects the newer data pull (it covers later work, from mid-February through March) and that inspecting a roadmap item still works.

expectations.outcome: The running roadmap reflects the updated export under data/uploads/985e2d4f7eb948b3b45a8f0923521ab8: work from the newer pull (mid-February through March, for example the on-call playbook automation work tracked as ENG-902357) appears on the roadmap alongside or in place of the original items, and roadmap items remain inspectable.

ui_flows.name: updated-content
ui_flows.steps: Open the roadmap. Look once over the items it shows for work that only appears in the newer data pull, such as on-call playbook automation (ENG-902357, 'Surgical agentlet: AutoFlow for on-call playbook execution and contextual helpers') or other items dated mid-February through March. One look is enough; do not repeat a check that has already answered.
ui_flows.expect: The roadmap includes work drawn from the newer pull, not only the items from the original upload.

ui_flows.name: drill-down
ui_flows.steps: Interact with an item to see lower level details.
ui_flows.expect: Interacting allows you to see more details than in the roadmap view.
